problem_statement.value: We need a way to keep a 3D-printed ceramic heat shield bonded to a metal flange through 800 thermal cycles without delaminating. Current designs using a silicone interlayer fail by cycle 200. Find and develop the strongest mechanism that solves this.

desired_outcome.value: Assume a stationary ground-test rig, an aluminium 6061 flange, under $40 per unit, no toxic or restricted chemistry, and a design we can validate in six weeks.
